response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is listed among skills but not a primary focus in any role, German proficiency is only basic (contradicting required fluency), and the resume portrays a senior/full-stack engineer with no evidence of entry-level readiness or interest in insurance-sector digitalization.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
Demonstrated agile practices and DevOps infrastructure experience
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting required fluency
Java is not a primary technology in any professional role shown
Overqualified for entry-level role with 10+ years of senior experience
